batting.name: RM Patidar
batting.dismissal: c M Jansen b YS Chahal

balls.text: wow, finally Jansen is able to launch a yorker away!! He backed away, and while always knowing that it would be a yorker, he has a full swing of the bat to fire the ball for a big six down the ground
this swings in to arrive on a yorker length on middle and off, and is driven hard to long-on
excellent consistency! This is a... yorker, and just outside off. Shashank looks to flash at it with a flat bat, but is beaten
what's the count of these yorkers? I've long lost it. This one tails back in to land on leg, as Jansen jams his bat down for a bottom-edged single to square leg
another yorker, which arrives on middle and off at 136kph. Shashank whips to long-on by staying deep in the crease
on a few bounces to the fine-leg fielder moving forward, as Hazlewood bowls on a back of a length on the stumps, and Jansen mistimes his pull. The ball went off the higher side of the bat there

dropped by Dayal at short third! He went grabbing at it while tumbling to his right, and the ball hardly stuck. Bhuvi bowled this wide of off after seeing Shashank shape for the scoop, but Shashank improvised and went for the reverse scoop instead. Eventually, the ball trickled off Dayal's fingers to give Shashank two
an attempted yorker on middle and off, and it arrives as a low full toss. Flung away to deep midwicket
Shashank walks down to try and distract Bhuvi, but you can do anything but that today. Bhuvi still nails it to land bang at the base of the bat, as Shashank jams it towards cover
Jitesh doves to his left and gets a hand, and takes the pace off the ball. It was a slower ball on a length on the stumps, and Jansen looked to hoick across the line, but got an inside edge
there's no answer to those inch-perfect yorkers!! This lands on off, and Shashank can only helicopter his way towards long-on
this time it is Bhuvi firing a yorker. This lands on off after angling in, and is dug out close to the pitch on the off side
another yorker, and this arrives on middle. Shashank opens his stance up, and whips it wide of short fine leg
perfect execution! Hazlewood launches another yorker, and this one is around sixth stump. Shashank looks to squeeze it out, but is beaten
another low full toss. Jansen makes room, and Hazlewood bowls just above his front toe. Clipped off the inside half of the bat to fine leg
a low full toss slanting into middle. Clipped to deep midwicket
short in length, and on off or thereabouts. Jansen shapes to pull, but then awkwardly slaps it towards deep point. The ball may have come on slower than expected
he sees Shashank backing away, and fires a yorker outside leg. Shashank can only squeeze it back on the pitch

Jansen looks to scoop, and is beaten. There's a light-hearted appeal for caught behind, but it's turned down. Patidar reviews, though. Replays confirm there is no bat or glove involved, so it stays not out. Jansen had got across the stumps at this length ball just outside off, and missed his attempted scoop
another full toss around the shin on off, and clipped to wide long-on
an attempted yorker results in a low full toss on middle, and Jansen chips it towards long-on
wide outside leg. It was quite full, and angling in. Jansen looked to flick but missed
yorker around seventh stump, and Shashank whips this to long-on
lofts this short-of-a-length ball on off towards long-off, as he mistimes the hit
bowls a slower ball on a short of a length just outside off. Jansen has a poke, but is beaten
fuller and flatter, and just outside off. He gets down to lap sweep but is struck on his front pad. The ball rolls to the off side for a leg bye
bang! Six down the ground! Jansen advances down the pitch, and gets to the pitch of what would otherwise have been a shortish ball around off, and has a liberal swing of his arms to bag six
short in length, and just outside off. It turns away, and is punched to long-on
short in length, and wide of off. He went slashing, but missed. Just short of being called wide
this is slower, but again full and on the stumps. Flicked to deep square leg
full and flat, and quicker one on the stumps. Driven to long-on
misfield at extra cover, and that is two runs. It was on the shorter side of a length, and outside off, as Jansen hacked hard
change of pace from Dayal, who goes at just 105kph, and on a fullish length on off. Jabbed towards short third by Shashank
Jansen us standing with his front leg out of the way, and looks to clobber this fullish ball on middle and off. But he gets it off the inside half of the bat to long-on
on a length on leg, and clipped to short midwicket, where another agile save prevents a run
fuller in length, and angling across to arrive on middle. Driven to mid-off, from where the throw keeps the non-striker on his toes
on a fullish length on the stumps, and Shashank gets across to clip it to deep midwicket
short in length, and a little wide of off. It turns in, and is dabbed back

lovely bowling! He has foxed two Australian batters within a matter of seconds. This time he hits the leg stump by bowling the googly. More importantly, Suyash slowed it down considerably to beat Stoinis. Suyash bowled on a length around middle and off, and got just the ideal dip and turn back in. Stoinis was trying to fend at it, but was completely beaten
now it is Bhuvi, the man at point who dives to his right, and gets a hand this time. Short and a little wide of off from Suyash, as Shashank cut hard at it
down the pitch first ball, and clips this fullish ball angling into leg. Kohli at midwicket dived to his right, but couldn't stop the ball

gone!! The off stump comes out. Suyash strikes, and gets the big one. He bowled this on a length on middle and off, and got a lot of sidespin there. Inglis had backed away to try and loft this over the off side, but was beaten by the invisible turn away from him. He missed, and the ball pinged the off stump
short in length on off, and there's a hint of turn away. Punched to long-on
full and just outside off, and driven to deep extra cover
superb work by Salt, as he sprints and dives forward from deep square leg, and ball falls just short after Shashank had a heave at this fullish ball around off
yorker, and angling in to arrive outside leg. Driven to deep extra cover

clears the man at long-on! For a second, I thought it would be Pandya's third wicket, but although it came off the inside half of Inglis' bat, it was timed well. He skipped down the pitch and converted this into a length ball on the stumps, and sent it flying
fuller ball, and just outside off. Swung away to long-on
good work by Kohli at extra cover, as he tumbles to his right to stop the ball after Shashank punched this length ball outside off

reverse scooped!! Inglis keeps PBKS ticking. He switches over early, and gets the perfect ball for the shot. It was a dipping yorker on off, and Inglis was ready and waiting to execute it perfectly over the keeper's head
shorter side of a length on middle and off, and again clipped to deep midwicket
short of a length on middle, and at just 116kph. He chips this towards deep midwicket
quick running there. A yorker on middle and off, and Inglis nudged it towards midwicket. The man was back on the boundary, and the batters pinched two
scooped over short fine leg! It was on a back of a length on off, but it shaped away to finish on leg, as Inglis got across the stumps, before waiting for the ball and dispatching it for four
bowls a scrambled-seam ball on length on middle and off, and Shashank leans into an aerial push to long-on
short of a length, and outside off. Punched to long-off
on a fullish length on middle and off, and punched to long-on
this is fuller and flatter, and also quicker at 96kph. It arrives just outside off, and as he looks to block towards cover, the ball hits his had and trickles away
ohh, this skids through! On a length on off, and barely turns away to beat Shashank's attempted push forward
lofted through extra cover! Full and flat around sixth stump, and he finds the gap between deep cover and long-off for four
very full on middle and off, and he skips down to clip to deep midwicket

Another mix-up, Shashank took off for a non-existent run. Sent back quickly enough, Krunal charged right but couldn't power the throw to the keeper as he was off balance. Was a full, slow ball that followed the batter as he made room. Defended off the front face
Full on leg, 98ks, clipped to midwicket
Slow and full on leg, big stride forward to block it towards midwicket
Backs away and cuts the length ball to sweeper cover
Full on off, punched to long-off
Goes back and flicks the shortish ball through midwicket

Mix-up, breakdown, two batters at one end. Relay throw to the keeper leads to a run out. Wadhera charged back for two, it was his call as he was running to the danger end, but Inglis took a step and showed his back. David ran left from long-on, turned and threw the ball in one motion meanwhile. Kohli ran towards the stumps from cover and fired it on the bounce to the keeper. Was a length ball on middle was punched into the pitch. Suyash jumped full length but the ball bounced above him. Turned out to be lucky in the end.
Edge goes through where slip would've been, short third runs right to stop it. Skiddy length ball on fourth, rushed Wadhera a bit as he tried to caress it with a diagonal bat
Smart two again. To the edge of the ring at midwicket again. Slow, shortish ball angling in was flicked softly
Almost sidearms that legbreak. 95ks but looked like a slow dragdown, worked back from fourth stump, to the bowler
Backs away and cuts the length ball to long-off
Wide release. Length ball on fourth, pushed with an open bat face towards third
Punched to point, Kohli spears a through at the non-striker's. Batters consider taking an overthrow but don't do it
Angle is a touch too sharp on this length ball, past the flick. Down leg.
Shortish ball on leg, slingy release, beats the flick. Goes off the pad to midwicket

Clothed... Krunal takes a stunner and RCB's newest entrant strikes in his first over. Krunal ran in from long-on, was racing to his left, took the catch around his chest while at full pace, he then tumbles down and throws the ball up in one motion. He's ecstatic as is Shepherd and Kohli, who gives the bowler a big hug. Was a full ball around middle and leg, Shreyas went back in the crease and thrashed it through the line, sliced it in the end. Bat-face opened on impact. It's boom or bust for him again
Sharp bouncer. Lands very short, line just outside off, pace 136ks. Shreyas ducks under it early.
Firmer flick to a similar ball. Same area again, goes quicker along the grass
Two pinched through midwicket. Gentle flick off the pad, from a length, played in a way that it nearly slows to a halt right after rolling past the ring
This one jumps up outside off from a length, Shreyas goes for the square drive. Bottom hand comes off and the ball pops off the outer-half of the bat towards point
Fullish ball on leg, under-edged pull goes behind square. Length was too full for the shot
Length down leg, 99ks, flicked to deep fine leg
Low fully at 86ks, much slower than usual, Shreyas leant well forward and was early on the flick. Got it back to the bowler
Punches the length ball at the stumps to long-on

Fielding restrictions done, and the deep fielder is in play right away. First ball of the seventh over is generally low scoring, batters look for singles due to said field spreading. But Prabhsimran charges and looks to slug it across the line. Bat-face turned inwards and he got square-on upon impact. David moves right from long-on, knew he was well in front of the ropes and took the head-high catch with a twirl.
On the pads, flicked to midwicket

Genuine edge taken from this cover drive, on the bounce to short third. Full ball, touch shorter than the last one though, on sixth. Shreyas not checking the shot, didn't lose grip either, but the timing was off
Overpitched, Shreyas' bottom hand comes off the cover drive. There's a close-in fielder, he's beaten to the left. Hazlewood being hit off his length, which is quite the rarity
Yorker outside off, steered to deep point

Amazing paddle over fine leg. Nothing about that 142ks length ball on seventh stump called for the shot, but the batter premeditated, got his back leg deep in the crease, was lunging across to the off side while getting the hands across and up
Length outside off, driven through cover
Doesn't carry back to the bowler. Followed again, Iyer tried to work the full ball through mid-on but got the ball hovering. Could be a case of going into the shot too early
Wide, but that's smart from Krunal.
Length on leg, guided to short fine. Saw Prabhsimran switching his stance for the reverse, so he fires a wide yorker that swerves well outside the tramline. Half-volleys the keeper who half-stops it
Risky but well-played sweep over short fine. Prabhsimran went across to fourth stump to a length ball on off, went through with the aerial sweep. Played it late
Makes room early, gets followed by a full ball, driven to long-off

Krunal slants it away from Priyansh's arc, gets him caught on the edge of the ring right behind him. 96ks stock ball was on a length, Priyansh swipes across - like a slog sweep aimed to go straight - but it hits too high. That's the risk that comes with trying to hit on the up
Not at the start. 100ks length ball on leg, clipped to midwicket. Looked slower than 100ks but he makes it look effortless
That's a bad ball given the field change. Full on seventh stump, allows Priyansh to access the off side. It's a flowing square drive in front of point.
Length on leg, beats the pull and pops off the flap of the pad towards short fine leg
Cross-seam ball beats the pull. Hard-length ball just over fourth stump, went under the bat. Ball likely to have hit the leather and not the seam
Priyansh shuffles to fourth stump before the ball was released, Hazlewood went a touch wider with the fullish ball but it was still dragged over mid-on.
Good ball, good running too. 138ks on a length, top of off, Prabhsimran pushes it towards point and takes off
Somehow, he hits the bat hard even on this pitch. Fullish ball just outside off, 137ks, bat face turns inward on the off-drive. Ball trickles past the bowler
Pulled into the ground. Through midwicket. Was a shortish ball on fourth, pace off the pitch seemed low. Batter generating the power there
Dances down again, Bhuvi goes a touch fuller but it's still length. Pushed defensively to Kohli at point, direct hit at the non-striker's leads to a big cheer
Dances down, slaps it through point. Made the fourth-stump short-of-length ball look wider than it was.
Length on the pads, flicked to midwicket
Touch back  length on fourth, Prabhsimrah walks down the pitch to negate potential sideways movement, tapped to point
Guided nicely. Through third it goes. Length ball just outside off, tapped on the head
Pulled off the bottom of the bat, ball floats in the air and lands just outside the ring at midwicket. Was a short-of length ball outside off, Priyansh dragged it
Pitched up just outside off, driven through cover. Firm punch, holds the shape too. Ball races between mid-off and cover.
Yorker on fourth, slanting in, Priyansh jams it towards cover. Fielder swoops in to deny the run
Pick-up pull over forward square leg. 134ks touch back of length, slanting in towards middle, Priyansh stands still and swings across the hips
Touch fuller and straighter, 134ks, pushed defensively to cover point's right
Edged, ball goes wide of third. Three-quarter length, angling away through fourth, Prabhsimran wanted to drive down the ground
Slower ball on a fullish length at leg stump, Priyansh had to check the flick. Touch uppish but goes safely to midwicket. Replays show it was a knuckle ball
The line is straighter. Shortish length, might've swung in. Beats the flick and hits him over the knee-roll
Length on fourth, a bit of shape away, Prabhsimram opens the face and nudges it towards point
And Priyansh drives to that fielder's left. Slightly on the up, three-quarter length just outside off
Tentative flick Priyansh started to close the bat face before straightening it to tap the stump-to-stump length ball back to the bowler
Interesting. Goes shortish first up, back of length around off, flicked to midwicket

six! The ball lands close to the RCB dugout over midwicket! Another short delivery from Wadhera, and this came around middle and leg. Jitesh was deep in the crease, and hammered the ball with his pull shot
this dips on a full length on leg, and Kohli guides this to point after getting his front leg out of the way
short on the stumps, and punched to long-off
short of a length on middle and leg, and punched towards the man at midwicket
on a short of a length on the stumps, and punched to long-on
down the pitch, and he drives this dipping and low full toss on leg. Single to deep cover
this dips on a full length on middle, and is slow again. Pushed aerially to long-off
Kohli backs away, and Brar bowls short and on leg. The ball angles in further, and is slapped to deep cover
full and straight, and driven to long-off
he skipped down the pitch, and Brar noticed that. He went slow and on a fullish length on middle, as Kohli chipped it to long-on
lofted wide of long-off, as he leans into this full and slow ball on the stumps
full and slow, and just wide of off. It turns away, and is slapped to deep cover
beaten! Full and loopy, and just outside leg. There's some extra bounce as well, and some turn away, as Jitesh looked to tonk to the leg side, but missed

Chahal strikes! Patidar looks to repeat some of Kohli's heroics, but can't clear long-on. Chahal had slowed it down nicely there, and got this to dip on a fullish length on the stumps. Patidar went lofting across the line, but mistimed the loft. Stoinis takes it with a reverse cup
very full on middle, and driven to long-off
whipped for four! It was a googly, and very full on leg, as Kohli read it well again for four to deep midwicket. Brilliant use of the wrists
clean loft down the ground! Kohli gets his front leg out of the way, and got to the pitch of this tossed-up ball dipping on middle to go for six
another short delivery, and this is around off. Kohli swat-pulls to deep midwicket
another short ball, and four this time! The ball rises nicely around fifth stump, and Kohli rides the bounce to ramp over short third

massive mix-up!! And RCB are lucky to not lose a wicket here. Short ball from Arshdeep around middle and off, which Kohli pulled to deep square leg. Kohli wanted a second and took off, only for Patidar to remain grounded. The throw arrived very wide at the non-striker's end, and although Iyer, who received the throw, had another shy at the bowler's end, it was still wide, and the batters could eventually get two
slower ball, and on a fullish length on middle. Punched to long-off
clipped off his pads, and it is cut off at fine leg by Shashank. Short of a length on leg from Arshdeep, and Patidar played it late by closing the face of the bat
angling across, and on a length wide outside off. Patidar throws his bat at it without any foot movement, and is beaten
angled in, and bowled on a fullish length just outside off. Driven down to long-off
angling across, and arrives as a yorker on off. Dug out to long-off to raise a 43-ball fifty
fuller and on sixth stump. He went driving without any foot movement, and missed
on a length, and pitching just outside off. But it finishes wider, and is pushed back to Jansen
back of a length, and angling across. It pitches on middle, and is dabbed to deep third
fullish and slow, and on his pads. Clipped to fine leg
full and straight, and much slower. This dips, and is blocked
this angles in, and lands full on leg. Hits his pad as he looked to flick it away
ohh, slower still from Chahal, who goes full and on the stumps. Kohli takes a good stride out to flick towards short fine leg
fuller and slower, and on middle. Pushed down to long-on
shorter side of a length on leg, and quicker too. Nudged to midwicket

shot of the day! A one-bounce four over extra cover, but he deserved more than six there. He backed away slightly, and lofted this length ball dipping on the stumps. Full face of the bat, and a high left elbow, and four!
shorter side again from Brar, who goes on middle. There's no turn there, and Patidar, too, punches hard to long-on
short of a length on middle and off, and punched to long-on
angled in, and full and outside off. Driven to long-off

taken at long-on!! Padikkal falls, and gives PBKS a sniff. He skips down the pitch, even as Brar bowls it on a length, and slow just outside off. Padikkal goes ahead with the slog across the line, but ends up finding the fielder, who is placed bang on the edge of the boundary, and who takes it with a reverse cup
length ball on middle, and slower this time. Flicked to deep square leg
on a length on the stumps, and punched to extra cover

Stoinis appeals confidently for lbw, but it is turned down. Inglis isn't sure, too. So PBKS don't review. This time Stoinis executes the yorker, getting it to swing in towards leg. Padikkal brought his bat down to jam at it, but was too late, and seemed to be struck outside leg
driven past mid-off! Stoinis attempts the yorker, but this goes as a low full toss angling across, and arrives on off. Padikkal goes hard at it to beat mid-off to his left
just goes over the rope down the ground! A length delivery on middle and leg, and Padikkal gets his front leg out of the way to calmly have a swing at it
he skips down the pitch, and Stoinis bangs it on a hard length just outside off. Swat-pulled to long-on
short ball on off, and pulled to deep square leg by rolling his wrists. Two more for Kohli
shorter side of a length just outside off, before the ball straightens after pitching. Kohli gets across before dabbing towards Stoinis
this dips and arrives as a very full ball on middle and off. Kohli drills it down long-on
veryyyy slow from Chahal, who bowls short on middle, and the ball turns belatedly to finish on leg. Pull to deep square leg
on a length on middle, and straightens after pitching. Clipped to fine leg
swept hard to deep-backward square leg, where Arshdeep and Arya combine in a relay effort. Full and angling into his pads, as Kohli went down to slog hard at that
short in length on middle, and punched to long-on to raise his fifty
fullish ball on the stumps, and driven back to Chahal's left. But there's a misfield, and that allows the single to long-off
Yorker on off, pushed to mid-off's left

Short third and backward point are in, Bartlett goes slow and into the pitch, offers width too. Padikkal helps himself to an effective free hit. Cuts it deep into the outfield, one-bounce four over third
Wide and slow on a three-quarter length, slapped to sweeper cover
Yorker on leg, nudged towards midwicket
Pulled flat over square leg. Cleared the front leg, picked the back-of-length ball up from the top of thigh.
Kohli charges and slaps it hard, finds deep point. Was a pace-on length ball outside off
Pulled, teases deep-backward square but Shashank can't stop it despite the slide to the right. Might've grazed his jaw on the way. Ball wasn't that short, pulled nicely. Along the ground
Darted length ball, 93ks, Padikkal switches late for a flourishing reverse sweep. Misses. Went hard at it, had to do too much in too little time
Full on middle, makes room and drives to long-off
Another dot. 90ks full ball on middle and off, Kohli makes room and drives straight
Full on leg, flicked to the left of short midwicket. Stopped with a dive
Cut to deep point. 91ks, fuller side of length on fifth stump, flat trajectory
Yorker on fourth, 121ks, jammed to backward point with the toe of the bat pointing almost towards the keeper
Low full toss on middle, whipped straight to midwicket. Padikkal misses out
Length n off, 141ks, squirted to point's right with the angled bat
Kohli makes room, Jansen goes wide of off. The length ball is well beyond Kohli's reach and the tramline
Three-quarter length, angling in towards middle, punched to long-on
Length on fourth, pulled to midwicket's left
Skiddy length ball on top of off, defended towards point
Loopy again. 87ks. Misfield from Chahal, ball goes towards mid-on to allow the single. Was a fullish ball on fourth that was defended with the full-faced bat
Slow, length ball on the pads, Kohli goes square-on to punch it to long-on
Loopy legbreak dips into a length. Landed around leg and spun down, shovelled to short fine
Punched off the back foot to long-on
Tight late dab. Played well to get it through the first-slip region. Was a length ball on fourth, skiddy, to get low bounce

Floated up, whacked over mid-on. Fifty partnership up. Chahal looking to shop for wickets, tosses up the legbreak on a full length in front of off, Padikkal took a big stride and whacked it across the line

Guided through third. Great shot. Lifted the bat next to his chest, opened the face to direct the shortish ball into the ground and in the gap/ Small twirl of the bat too, short third is beaten to the right, Kohli punches his bat in delight
Out? No, clears Shreyas who was running back from mid-off. Stopped close to the ropes. Was a full ball that Kohli tried to launch down the ground, got it off the toe. RCB's fifty up btw
Tucked off the pads through the leg side, rapid running again
Flayed. Not off the middle but gets four to third. Pitched up outside off, Kohli looks to go over cover, gets an edge that cleared the infield

Confusion, both batters freeze momentarily after taking off. For Kohli, Kohli turns back and manages to slide the bat past the crease as the direct hit from point connects. Was a length ball in the channel that was defended
Full outside off, driven to cover
Full on leg, lots of revs on that, Kohli makes room and drives to long-off
Bunts the wide ball to cover
Padikkal dances down, Harpreet goes flatter and wider. Padikkal steers it off a length through point while stretching his back foot into the crease
Makes room and cuts, finds point
Driven down the ground, finds the fielder in the deep
Not at the start, Kohli manufactures a lofted drive over cover. Opened the face fully, lifted it off a fullish length. Would've been bowled had he missed it, risky but skilful
Length on middle, flicked to midwicket's left. They look for a quick single, Padikkal's sent back
Full on off from around the wicket, 135ks, defended to point

Misfield by Arshdeep at short, he went low to the left but could only half-stop it. Backward point runs to the deep to stop it. Was a length ball on fourth, Padikkal went back in the crease and dabbed it late
Thumped through the line, like a leaner Matt Hayden. Padikkal walks down the pitch to a fullish ball, was either the scrambled seam or cutter, and drove it flat
Full around fourth, pushed to cover
Dances down and flogs it off a length to midwicket

Deep square leg was sent out and Padikkal exploits the newly created gap at midwicket. Runs four! Was a length ball on middle to which he went back and flicked. Fielder used his foot to cut the ball close to the ropes, but he ran past the boundary and had to track back. Replays show just how quick the batters were, Padikkal - in an attempt to avoid collision - was two pitches beside the main one
Pitched up on fourth, punched with a straight bat to mid-off's right
Length around middle, goes across and flicks towards midwicket
Yorker on off, jammed to cover
Padikkal connects with the upper cut this time. He didn't just steer it, had to flick his wrist and raise the bumper over the keeper. Was a short ball around off that was slow off the pitch
Beaten on the upper cut. Short ball just outside off, Padikkal's bat was mostly vertical from the spin-on vision

Big lbw appeal, is that going down? Not given, Bartlett is confident. PBKS go for it. Wonder if Bartlett thought Kohli went across, the first replay shows that middle and off stump were visible as the fullish ball beat the flick and hit the front pad. Bartlett collects his cap and sighs before hawk-eye shows that it'd go down leg
Shortish just outside off, ball's slow off the pitch, Kohli waits and punches it off the back foot to cover
Length just outside off, defensive push towards point
Fullish on leg, flicked to deep square leg's left. 137ks
Length at the pads, beaten on the flick
Overpitched and that's punched straight of mid-off. Perfect timing. Off-stump line, Kohli was a touch across the line but right behind it and showed the full face

Arshdeep celebrappeals, Salt doesn't move but will walk after the ump raises his finger. Ball similar to the one Kohli pulled for four earlier. This was 123ks, landed very short and angled away through off, Salt was beside the line and looked to pull it square, his eyes were pointed towards midwicket as he swung - very much off the ball. The ball grazed the edge and skimmed above his shoulder.

Quick single to mid-on's right, Arshdeep reached out with his left hand in follow-through, when he didn't touch the ball Kohli charged. Was a length ball on fifth, attempted cut was spliced into the pitch
Fullish on off, 135ks, pushed softly towards cover
Pulled from in front of the face. 125ks bumper, landed short, direction was good but the pace not so. Kohli had ample time to swivel and pump it through midwicket
Fullish on fifth, angling away, square driven to deep point. 132ks
Late inswing. Full ball in at middle and leg, whipped to mid-on
